subject.title: feat: ask_user — structured questions from the agent with web card, channel buttons, and text answers

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this in-memory provider-neutral `question.*` Gateway API and `ask_user` tool as the permanent cross-provider interaction contract after the scoped compatibility repair?
rationale: The PR creates a new public Gateway scope, RPC/event family, and plugin-facing runtime seam spanning agents, channels, web UI, and native clients; the long-term contract boundary cannot be selected safely by automated review alone.

options.title: Sponsor after compatibility repair
options.body: Accept the provider-neutral direction, require native profile scope coverage and final-head behavior proof, then review the resulting public contract.

options.title: Narrow the first release
options.body: Limit the feature to the existing Codex-specific or web surface until a broader Gateway/plugin contract is explicitly designed.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after compatibility repair
recommendation.body: Accept the provider-neutral direction, require native profile scope coverage and final-head behavior proof, then review the resulting public contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest available implementation history across the adjacent Codex question work and this provider-neutral follow-on.
